answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 7147 Country: United Kingdom Title: In our Masjid there is a very big hall which is separate from the Jamaat Khana,When you enter the big hall comes first then there is a separate room with a door which is the Jamaat khana, is it permissible to pray Janazah salaah in the big hall which is ouside the Jamaat khana? please provide refrence. Question: Asalamualaikum Q) In our Masjid there is a very big hall which is separate from the Jamaat Khana,When you enter the big hall comes first then there is a separate room with a door which is the Jamaat khana, is it permissible to pray Janazah salaah in the big hall which is ouside the Jamaat khana? please provide refrence. Answer ID: 7147 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1028/910=L/1429) The salah of janazah can be offered in the hall if it is not included in the mosque area. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
